node.title: C2'' reduced primitive-residue joint reserve
node.statement: For every admissible prize row R, first remove every quotient/coset class owned by the structured staircase column. With A(R)=product_j E_U[rho_j] and X_prim(R)=q^{-t+H}W_cen^prim(R)=E_U[product_j rho_j]_reduced, the remaining primitive joint loss satisfies X_prim(R)<=2^21 A(R). Primitive noncoset accidents are charged at absolute weight with unique ownership. No unreduced endpoint, factorization equality, or uniform per-junction bound is asserted.
node.attack_surface: Use the exact primitive telescoping identity and prove or refute 2^(nm)(Z_0-C_1)<=2^21 Z_m product_(j<m)B_j, where C_1=Z_0(q,n/2,t/2). Preserve the raw-count subtraction before taking logarithms or bounds.
node.falsifier: An admissible row with q^{-t+H}W_cen^prim>2^21 product_j E_U[rho_j] under generated-field normalization and first-owner rules.
node.notes: Rounds 23--26 established exact telescoping, periodic-stratum, freeze-tail, and saturated-constant results for the unreduced object. Round 27 refutes the unreduced endpoint. Round 28 pays first-owner deletion. Round 29 reduces the target to the positive integer inequality C2-INT. Round 30 preregisters J_prim<=sqrt(2n), which would close the 21-bit reserve, and finds no falsifier on 13 exact t=2 rows through n=256. Round 31 proves the first-junction support overlap. Rounds 32--33 bank exact m=1 and m=2 survivors and expose first-factor/tail cancellation. Round 34 repackages the complete all-depth ratio as one primitive correlation excess among dyadic Haar-band null events on the same Bernoulli cube. The resulting square-root correlation inequality remains open.
